messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "call doctor if bleeding will not stop"
set: ["call doctor if bleeding will not stop", "any bleeding that will not stop", "bruising or bleeding that will not stop", "tell doctor or seek emergency medical attention if bleeding will not stop", "seek emergency medical attention for bleeding that will not stop", "stop using and call doctor at once if signs of stomach bleeding", "call doctor at once if signs of bleeding", "call doctor if symptoms do not improve", "call your doctor if they do not itch", "stop taking and call doctor at once if symptoms occur", "stop using and call doctor at once if painful urination", "call your doctor at once if symptoms of stomach bleeding occur", "stop taking and call doctor right away", "stop using and call doctor at once", "call doctor if diarrhea occurs", "stop using and call doctor at once if coughing up blood"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "tell doctor or seek emergency medical attention if bleeding will not stop",
    "seek emergency medical attention for bleeding that will not stop",
    "call doctor at once if signs of bleeding",
    "call your doctor if they do not itch",
    "call your doctor at once if symptoms of stomach bleeding occur",
    "stop taking and call doctor right away",
    "stop using and call doctor at once",
    "call doctor if symptoms do not improve"
  ],
  "alias": "call doctor if bleeding will not stop"
}
